metaShifts.description: Following the previous patch's strong buffs to illusions and summons, this patch introduces targeted nerfs to several key illusion heroes (Morphling, Phantom Lancer) and summon-focused heroes (Beastmaster, Visage). The Safety Bubble interaction with illusions also adds a layer of vulnerability. However, Naga Siren receives buffs, indicating a fine-tuning of the archetype rather than a complete removal, aiming for a more balanced power curve.

This patch significantly buffs several aggressive, front-line core heroes such as Huskar, Lina, Juggernaut, and Bristleback. These changes enhance their survivability, damage output, or sustain, reinforcing a meta where durable, impactful cores can thrive and dictate the pace of engagements. This aligns with the previous patch's emphasis on melee core aggression.

A notable shift in the support landscape is evident, with several previously strong or popular supports (Dazzle, Shadow Shaman, Abaddon, Visage) receiving nerfs. Conversely, Snapfire receives significant buffs. This indicates a re-evaluation of the preferred support pool, favoring heroes with more direct impact, better scaling, or stronger synergy with the empowered aggressive cores.

Heroes renowned for their high mobility, snowball potential, or ability to relentlessly stick to targets (Riki, Meepo, Troll Warlord, Primal Beast) have received nerfs to their movement speed, agility gain, or slow resistance. This trend aims to slightly temper the game's tempo and make it more challenging for highly mobile, early-game dominant heroes to snowball out of control.

synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: Lina's buffs to base Strength, Agility gain, and Flame Cloak's magic resistance and duration make her significantly more durable and scale better into the mid and late game. This synergizes perfectly with her high burst damage, allowing her to play more aggressively and survive longer in teamfights, especially against magic-heavy lineups.

The buffs to Burning Spear's max health burn and Life Break's cooldown and magic resistance during the leap amplify Huskar's core aggressive, diving playstyle. He becomes even more potent at snowballing and sustaining through fights, directly benefiting from the 'Aggressive Core Empowerment' meta shift.

The refresh of his Unknown Ability (1910) upon casting Phantasm is a substantial buff to Chaos Knight's illusion uptime and burst potential. This synergizes with his existing kit, allowing for more consistent pressure and damage, especially in a meta that still values strong melee cores and illusion presence.

Juggernaut's Bladeform max stacks increase and Healing Ward mana cost reduction improve his damage output and sustain. This allows him to farm more efficiently, stay healthier in lane, and contribute more consistently to pushes and teamfights, aligning with the 'Aggressive Core Empowerment' theme.

The cooldown reduction on Firesnap Cookie and mana cost reduction on Lil' Shredder make Snapfire's abilities far more spammable. This enhances her laning presence, burst damage, and mobility, allowing her to be a more impactful support or core in the 'Support Roster Shake-up' and 'Aggressive Core Empowerment' meta.

synergisticLosers.synergyExplanation: The removal of Aghanim's Scepter multicast for several abilities and the Ogre Magi Morph multicast are massive nerfs to Morphling's versatility and burst potential. These changes directly target specific high-impact builds, significantly reducing his overall power ceiling and making him less adaptable in the 'Illusion & Summon Rebalancing' meta.

Riki suffers from multiple nerfs across his base Agility, level 1 damage, Smoke Screen cooldown, and Cloak and Dagger XP bonuses. These changes severely cripple his early game impact, laning phase, and ability to snowball, directly countering the 'Mobility & Snowball Deterrence' meta shift.

Meepo receives significant nerfs to his base movement speed, Agility gain, and Divided We Stand experience penalty. These changes collectively hinder his farming efficiency, mobility, and ability to snowball, making him much weaker in all stages of the game and directly impacted by the 'Mobility & Snowball Deterrence' trend.

Dazzle is hit with multiple nerfs to his base Intelligence, level 1 damage, Nothl Projection Shard range, and Shadow Wave Cast Range talent. These changes collectively reduce his early game presence, laning power, and overall utility, making him a less impactful support in the 'Support Roster Shake-up' meta.

The damage reduction on Illusory Armaments directly weakens Phantom Lancer's core illusion damage output. This nerf, combined with the broader 'Illusion & Summon Rebalancing' trend, makes him less effective at farming, pushing, and dealing damage in teamfights.

Carry.explanation: Direct buffs to Burning Spear's damage and Life Break's cooldown and magic resistance make Huskar an even more formidable aggressive carry. He thrives on diving and sustaining through damage, perfectly fitting the 'Aggressive Core Empowerment' theme.

The increased Bladeform stacks and reduced Healing Ward mana cost enhance Juggernaut's sustain and damage output, making him a more reliable and potent carry in both the laning phase and teamfights, benefiting from the 'Aggressive Core Empowerment' trend.

The refresh of his Unknown Ability (1910) on Phantasm cast significantly boosts Chaos Knight's illusion uptime and burst potential, making him a stronger hard carry capable of sustained damage and pressure.

A minor cooldown reduction on Flak Cannon slightly improves Gyrocopter's farming speed and teamfight damage, making him a more consistent ranged carry option in a meta that still values strong damage output.

Buffs to Eelskin's evasion per Naga and its radius make her illusions more durable and enhance her teamfight presence. This solidifies her position as a strong illusion carry, even amidst the 'Illusion & Summon Rebalancing'.

Mid.explanation: Significant buffs to her base Strength, Agility gain, and Flame Cloak's magic resistance and duration make Lina a much more survivable and scalable mid-lane core. She can play more aggressively and sustain through fights, capitalizing on her high burst damage.

The buffs to Burning Spear and Life Break make Huskar an even more dominant mid-lane presence. His ability to snowball and aggressively dive targets is amplified, making him a top-tier choice for controlling the mid-lane.

Reduced cooldown on Firesnap Cookie and lower mana cost on Lil' Shredder make Snapfire a highly spammable and impactful mid. She can control the lane, set up ganks, and contribute significant burst damage, fitting the 'Support Roster Shake-up' into a core role.

The cooldown reduction on Reaper's Scythe increases Necrophos's ultimate uptime, making him a more consistent threat in teamfights. His inherent sustain and damage from Death Pulse also make him a strong, durable mid-lane presence.

The damage increase on Talon Toss significantly improves Kez's burst potential and laning presence. This makes him a more viable aggressive mid-lane hero, capable of securing kills and dominating the lane.

Offlane.explanation: Buffs to his base Intelligence and Level 25 Bristleback Damage Threshold Reduction talent improve his mana pool and late-game tankiness. The Reactive Armor stacks from misses also enhance his durability, making him an even more formidable front-line offlaner.

The buff to his Level 10 Health Regen talent improves Centaur Warrunner's early game sustain, making him a more resilient and difficult-to-dislodge offlaner who can absorb pressure and initiate effectively.

While his Unknown Ability (1921) marks can now be dispelled, the 1200 unit range for application encourages active, aggressive play, which Lycan thrives on. This is a net gain for an offlane Lycan focused on early pressure and objective taking.

Reduced cooldown on Firesnap Cookie and lower mana cost on Lil' Shredder make Snapfire a highly spammable and impactful offlaner. She can control the lane, set up ganks, and contribute significant burst damage, fitting the 'Support Roster Shake-up' into a core role.

The Level 10 Wrath of Nature base damage buff slightly improves Nature's Prophet's global presence and farming efficiency. This makes him a more impactful offlaner who can split push effectively and contribute to fights from anywhere on the map.

SoftSupport.explanation: The reduced cooldown on Firesnap Cookie and lower mana cost on Lil' Shredder make Snapfire an incredibly spammable and impactful soft support. She excels at controlling the lane, setting up kills, and providing burst damage, making her a top pick in the 'Support Roster Shake-up'.

Lina's buffs to survivability and scaling, while primarily benefiting her as a core, also make her a stronger aggressive soft support. Her high burst damage and increased durability allow her to contribute significantly to early skirmishes and scale better into the mid-game.

The cooldown reduction on Reaper's Scythe increases Necrophos's ultimate uptime, making him a more consistent threat. His Death Pulse provides strong sustain and damage, making him a valuable soft support for both healing and securing kills.

The mana cost reduction on Healing Ward makes Juggernaut a more viable niche soft support. He can provide significant sustain for his lane partner and contribute to early pushes, offering a unique utility role.

The damage increase on Talon Toss significantly improves Kez's burst potential and laning presence. This makes him a more viable aggressive soft support, capable of securing kills and dominating the lane with his high damage output.

HardSupport.explanation: The reduced cooldown on Firesnap Cookie and lower mana cost on Lil' Shredder make Snapfire an incredibly spammable and impactful hard support. She excels at controlling the lane, setting up kills, and providing burst damage, making her a top pick in the 'Support Roster Shake-up'.

Lina's buffs to survivability and scaling, while primarily benefiting her as a core, also make her a stronger aggressive hard support. Her high burst damage and increased durability allow her to contribute significantly to early skirmishes and scale better into the mid-game.

The cooldown reduction on Reaper's Scythe increases Necrophos's ultimate uptime, making him a more consistent threat. His Death Pulse provides strong sustain and damage, making him a valuable hard support for both healing and securing kills.

The mana cost reduction on Healing Ward makes Juggernaut a more viable niche hard support. He can provide significant sustain for his lane partner and contribute to early pushes, offering a unique utility role.

The damage increase on Talon Toss significantly improves Kez's burst potential and laning presence. This makes him a more viable aggressive hard support, capable of securing kills and dominating the lane with his high damage output.

Carry.explanation: Nerfs to base movement speed, Agility gain, and Divided We Stand XP penalty severely hinder Meepo's ability to farm, snowball, and escape. These changes make him a much weaker carry, especially in a meta that deters high mobility and snowballing.

The removal of Aghanim's Scepter multicast for several abilities and Ogre Magi Morph multicast are massive nerfs to Morphling's versatility and burst potential, directly impacting his effectiveness as a hard carry.

Decreased attack damage on Stifling Dagger and reduced attack speed from Phantom Strike significantly lower Phantom Assassin's burst damage and overall attack speed, making her less effective at securing kills and farming as a carry.

Reduced movement speed bonuses from Berserker's Rage and Battle Trance severely impact Troll Warlord's ability to chase, stick to targets, and maneuver in fights, making him a less effective aggressive melee carry.

Minor nerfs to Agility gain and increased mana cost for Bone Guard slightly reduce Wraith King's armor and sustain. While not massive, these small reductions make him marginally less tanky and more vulnerable as a hard carry.

Mid.explanation: Nerfs to base movement speed, Agility gain, and Divided We Stand XP penalty severely hinder Meepo's ability to farm, snowball, and escape. These changes make him a much weaker mid, especially in a meta that deters high mobility and snowballing.

The removal of Aghanim's Scepter multicast for several abilities and Ogre Magi Morph multicast are massive nerfs to Morphling's versatility and burst potential, directly impacting his effectiveness as a mid-lane core.

Multiple nerfs to base stats, damage, Smoke Screen, and XP gain significantly reduce Riki's early game impact and ability to snowball from mid, making him a much weaker mid-lane hero in the 'Mobility & Snowball Deterrence' meta.

Decreased attack damage on Stifling Dagger and reduced attack speed from Phantom Strike significantly lower Phantom Assassin's burst damage and overall attack speed, making her less effective at securing kills and farming from mid.

The decreased duration of Stone Gaze reduces the impact of Medusa's ultimate in teamfights, making her a slightly less potent mid-lane presence, especially when trying to control aggressive enemy cores.

Offlane.explanation: Nerfs to Thunderhide's base health, magic resistance, and Slam slow duration significantly reduce the tankiness and control provided by his summoned units. This weakens his offlane presence, push potential, and overall teamfight contribution.

The decreased slow resistance from Colossal makes Primal Beast more susceptible to slows, reducing his ability to initiate, stay on targets, and escape in the offlane. This directly counters his aggressive, front-line playstyle.

Nerfs to Withering Mist's health restoration reduction, Aphotic Shield's cooldown, and Curse of Avernus's DPS talent collectively reduce Abaddon's sustain, utility, and damage output, making him a weaker offlaner who struggles to trade effectively.

Decreased Intelligence gain, damage gain per level, and increased Silent as the Grave cooldown reduce Visage's scaling and uptime. These nerfs make him a weaker offlaner who relies heavily on his Familiars, which are also impacted by the 'Illusion & Summon Rebalancing'.

Reduced movement speed bonuses from Berserker's Rage and Battle Trance severely impact Troll Warlord's ability to chase, stick to targets, and maneuver in fights, making him a less effective aggressive offlaner.

The increased cooldown on Shackles is a minor but impactful nerf that reduces Shadow Shaman's control uptime. This makes him slightly less effective at locking down targets and setting up kills as a soft support.

Nerfs to Withering Mist's health restoration reduction, Aphotic Shield's cooldown, and Curse of Avernus's DPS talent collectively reduce Abaddon's sustain, utility, and damage output, making him a weaker soft support who struggles to trade effectively and protect allies.

The decreased illusion movement speed from Dark Portrait reduces the utility and impact of Grimstroke's illusions. This makes him a slightly less effective soft support, as his ability to scout, push, and harass is diminished.
